section: Reports Suite > Work In Progress > WIP - Exports
title: Downloads carry the same Unit and VIN text the screen shows
refs: SV-8665 (WIP spec v28 2026-08-24 Story 9 S9-R14 - the Unit and VIN download cells carry the on-screen text including the placeholders; ruled by Chris Ward 2026-08-20; S4-R8 the on-screen Asset and VIN placeholders)
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The Asset and VIN columns are both turned on in the Work In Progress report.
3. Three ZZAUTOTEST open work orders are listed in the same tab: one for an asset that has both a unit number and a vehicle identification number, one for an asset that has a vehicle identification number but no unit number, and one for an asset that has neither.
steps:
1. Open the Work In Progress report and select the tab holding the three seeded work orders.
2. Write down exactly what the Asset cell and the VIN cell show on each of the three rows.
3. Open the three-dot menu in the toolbar and choose "Download (CSV)".
4. Open the downloaded file and read the "Unit" and "VIN" cells on the same three rows.
5. Open the three-dot menu again, choose "Download (PDF)", and read the same two cells on the same three rows there.
expected:
1. In both the downloaded file types, the "Unit" cell on each row carries exactly the text the Asset cell showed on screen for that row.
2. For the asset with no unit number, the "Unit" cell carries that asset's vehicle identification number - the same value the screen showed - and is not blank.
3. For the asset with neither a unit number nor a vehicle identification number, the "Unit" cell reads "Unknown", exactly as the screen showed.
4. The "VIN" cell carries exactly what the VIN column showed on screen, and reads "Unknown" on every row where the vehicle identification number is missing.
5. Neither cell is ever blank on a row where the screen showed text.
6. The download headings read "Unit" and "Branch" where the screen reads "Asset" and "Location" - that heading difference is expected and is not what this test is checking.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per the Work In Progress report specification version 28 (Story 9, S9-R14, with the on-screen placeholders it points at in Story 4, S4-R8), read on 26 August 2026, under epic SV-8582 and its story SV-8665.

AUTOMATION: READY
